svg.aria-label: The stack in five strata — interfaces (flutter, nuxt web and webapp), api (laravel with octane, sanctum, pennant, horizon, reverb, pest), data (postgres, redis, s3), cloud (aws, cloudflare), ship (docker swarm, ghcr, google play plus testflight, loki, grafana, discord) — worlds arise from the cloud substrate upward
